tools.name: find_machines
tools.description: Filter researched machines by process, material/use, reference budget, buying-link market and workshop requirements. Unknown requirements do not satisfy explicit filters. Market links do not imply stock.

tools.name: compare_machines
tools.description: Compare two to four known machine IDs using dated specifications, setup requirements, strengths, limitations and sources. No overall score or invented compatibility.

tools.name: get_buying_options
tools.description: Read existing retailer links for one machine and an explicitly chosen buyer country. Includes affiliate disclosures and dated observations; never purchases or confirms live stock.

tools.name: calculate_laser_setup
tools.description: Add a user-supplied machine quote and explicitly selected accessory costs in one currency. Include all eight checklist entries; use null for an unknown cost, not an assumed zero.

tools.name: calculate_maker_price
tools.description: Calculate a starting selling price from explicit per-item costs, machine/hands-on minutes, hourly costs, user-supplied fees and a profit buffer. No fee lookup or currency conversion.

tools.name: calculate_etsy_payback
tools.description: Calculate profit, break-even sales/months and capacity from explicit user inputs. No tax or wage deduction; no predicted sales or prefilled Etsy fees.

tools.name: find_laser_material
tools.description: Return the existing cautious source-level laser/material/task guidance and sources. Unknown material means stop. This is not certification of safety or exact machine compatibility.
